baseline_trigger.formula: current completed close < immediately previous eligible completed bar low

preserved_memory_predicate: completed_4h_close > max(entry_price, prior eligible post-entry highs)

redesign_hypotheses.formula: after first memory, first strictly-later completed 4H close < the prior_structural_high that the first memory bar broke
redesign_hypotheses.interpretation: confirmed failed hold of the exact breakout level

redesign_hypotheses.formula: after first memory, first strictly-later completed 4H close < low of the first memory bar
redesign_hypotheses.interpretation: confirmed full breakdown beneath the bar that established memory

redesign_hypotheses.formula: after first memory, freeze the first strictly-later completed bar whose high < immediately previous eligible completed bar high; then require a still-later completed close < that witness bar low
redesign_hypotheses.interpretation: two-stage lower-high then confirmed support break

redesign_hypotheses.formula: after first memory, first strictly-later completed 4H close < entry_price
redesign_hypotheses.interpretation: favorable structure ultimately fails back beneath entry

selection_rule.reason: Only exact boundary behavior is adjudicated: zero means inert and equality with the memory denominator means no lifecycle-level filtering. No arbitrary percentage threshold is introduced.
selection_rule.winner_rule: select the first survivor in frozen semantic priority order; do not rank or choose by lowest incidence
